regional_summary_6h.headline: MENA Index 2.19 (STABLE, steady): Iran Drives Tensions

bullets.text: Iran's military conflict with the US remains a major concern, with ongoing threats of new strikes and a united front from Iranian leaders
Iran's allied militias are proving their value in Tehran's widening war, with Israel assessing that Iran will fire missiles at it even if it doesn't initially join the conflict
The US-Iran war has also raised concerns in neighboring countries, including Saudi Arabia, which is gearing up for a possible ground invasion on Iranian-backed Houthis
